_note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Ramkrishna Forgings, consolidated, Rs crore, Screener basis. Revenue growth comes from the three-line build below (standalone domestic, standalone exports, subsidiaries and other net of eliminations), synced by RKFORGE.ctx.js. EBITDA margin is on the company basis (before the share of the rail-wheel JV, which we carry in other income). Shares: 18.557 cr after the 24-Sep-2026 warrant conversion (RKFORGE.patch.js); the Rs202.7 cr of warrant money received after Mar-26 is in the Mar-26 opening balance sheet.
_revenueWhy: From the build. FY27E ~+20%: Q1FY27 +19.8% (standalone domestic +20%, exports +11%, subsidiaries +49%); Q2FY26 was the tariff-hit base (exports -32% YoY), so Q2-Q3 growth is easy; management expects 'almost 20% plus' export growth, Rs400-500 cr more casting revenue, Mexico from Q3 and higher press/casting utilisation. FY28E-29E: utilisation rising from 68% (Q1FY27) towards 80%, which management says is the point of the next capex. Management's Rs8,000 cr FY29 target (22-25% CAGR) is ~20% above our FY29E: the same target was set for FY28 and slipped a year.
_marginWhy: Company basis (before the JV share). FY26 15.2% (14.8% on Screener's basis, which nets the JV loss), Q4FY26 17.1%, Q1FY27 18.0% with a 54% gross margin. Management promises improvement 'every quarter' and wants the old 21-22% back but gives no range; energy, gas and shipping costs (West Asia conflict) are not passed on and the new casting, Mexico and press capacity run below normal use. We stop ~2.5pp short of the FY22-24 margins: 18.3% / 19.0% / 19.3%.
_capexWhy: FY27: ~Rs350 cr guided (Q1FY27 call; Q4 call Rs300-400 cr incl. ~Rs50 cr into the wheel JV). FY28: no major capex until end-FY28 by management's account, but Rs10-20 cr for Inconel/titanium heating and maintenance on a Rs4,000 cr gross block: Rs350 cr. FY29: the next growth phase that management says it will announce at end-FY28: Rs450 cr. FY24-26 actual (cash flow, investing): Rs1,117 / 912 / 929 cr.
_depWhy: FY26 Rs333 cr; Q1FY27 Rs99 cr (Rs396 cr annualised) after the Q4FY26 capitalisation of the new press lines and the casting plant. The engine depreciates capex at once and holds CWIP flat; the rate gives ~Rs410 cr in FY27E.
_treasuryWhy: Net debt (~Rs1,900 cr at Jun-26 per the CFO), so no treasury yield; deposit interest sits in otherIncome.
_otherIncomeWhy: Built, not plugged. (1) Recurring other income ~Rs12 cr a year: FY26 Rs13.1 cr before exceptional items (AR FY26), Q1FY27 Rs3 cr; FY28-29E Rs12 / 14 cr. (2) Share of the 51% rail-wheel JV (equity method): FY26 -Rs17.9 cr before commercial production; FY27E -Rs8 cr (samples in Aug-26, bulk supply from Sep/Oct-26 against a 40,000-wheel FY27 offtake), FY28E +Rs8 cr, FY29E +Rs16 cr as 80,000+ wheels a year run through a 2.3 lakh-wheel plant. Totals Rs4 / 20 / 30 cr. Screener's TTM other income (Rs2 cr) is after exceptional items (FY26 -Rs10.7 cr net).
_interestLabel: Interest (term loans, working capital, bill discounting, leases)
_interestWhy: FY26 Rs212 cr; Q1FY27 Rs57 cr. Net debt Rs1,990 cr (Mar-26) to Rs1,900 cr (Jun-26); management targets ~Rs1,500 cr by Mar-27, helped by Rs202.7 cr of promoter warrant money (Jun and Sep-2026). ~Rs57 / 55 / 52 / 50 cr a quarter in FY27, then Rs180 / 165 cr as net debt falls towards ~1x EBITDA.
_taxWhy: Statutory 25.17% (new regime). FY26 book tax 14.5% (deferred-tax adjustments) and FY25 a Rs193 cr credit (deferred tax asset on ACIL's losses): both one-offs. Q1FY27 27.6%. Book tax 26% / 25.5% / 25.5%; cash tax stays lower while the ACIL losses are used.
_payoutWhy: FY26 Rs1/share (25% of a depressed profit); FY23-25 payout 9-14% (Screener). Deleveraging comes first: 12%.

build._note: Revenue build (Rs crore). Base FY26 from the Q4FY26/Q1FY27 investor presentations: standalone domestic Rs2,541.5 cr, standalone exports Rs1,186.6 cr; other = consolidated revenue (Rs4,238.1 cr) less the two (export incentives, subsidiaries net of eliminations). Checked against model revenue in RKFORGE.ctx.js.
build._why: Domestic: Q1FY27 +20%; quarterly path ~Rs735 / 690 / 760 / 840 cr against Rs611 / 516 / 662 / 752 cr a year earlier; CV demand firm (FY26 CV retail +11.7%; ICRA sees +4-6% in FY27), new casting line inside RKFL, PV/2W orders (Rs278 cr in Q1) and trailer axles (~Rs120 cr to ~Rs250 cr). Then +15% / +12% as press use rises towards 85%. Exports: FY26 -20% (US tariffs, Class 8 down 13-14%); Q1FY27 +11%; base quarters Rs278 / 271 / 319 cr; management 'almost 20% plus': we take +18%, then +15% / +13% on the order book (Rs2,800 cr of programme revenue for FY28 in the Q4 deck). Other (subsidiaries net): Q1 +49%; castings (RCSL), Mexico from Q3: +30% / +20% / +15%.

dcf._betaWhy: The engine discounts at the cost of equity. With net debt ~Rs1,700 cr against a ~Rs13,000 cr market value (D/V ~12%), a cost of equity of ~13.4% (beta 1.15, cyclical CV forgings) and post-tax debt cost ~6.8% give a WACC of ~12.6%; beta 1.0 sets the discount rate at 12.5%, close to that WACC.
dcf._tgWhy: 5.5%: middle of the house range; forgings grow with CVs, industrial capex and railways, with no pricing power above inflation.
dcf._fadeGrowthWhy: Revenue growth fades from ~13% to 7% over 15 years.
dcf._fadeMarginWhy: 18% steady-state EBITDA margin: FY22-24 averaged ~21.6%, FY25-26 13.9-15.2%; we sit between.
dcf._fadeCapexWhy: Capex 6% of revenue in steady state (FY22-26: 15-30%, a build-out phase); depreciation 5.5%.

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Exports recover fully (US Class 8 upturn, new European and EV programmes), the wheel JV and castings fill quickly and energy costs ease: growth ~4pp a year higher and EBITDA margin +1.2pp, back towards the FY22-24 levels.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: A domestic CV downturn, US tariffs and weak Class 8 demand return, energy and freight stay high and new plants run half empty: growth ~6pp a year lower and EBITDA margin -2.5pp (FY25-26 levels).

methods.name: P/E
methods.why: How the street values Ramkrishna Forgings: P/E on FY28E EPS (Dalal & Broacha 27x FY28E, 1-Jun-2026). Multiple derived in RKFORGE.ctx.js (own forward-P/E median on EPS before one-offs, trough years left out, x the auto-component de-rating) and written by syncMultiples().

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.why: Cross-check: own trailing EV/EBITDA median since Apr-2021 x the sector de-rating, restated to Sep-28E EBITDA; net debt deducted.

methods.name: DCF
methods.why: 15-year FCFF at 12.5% (close to the WACC) and 5.5% terminal growth, less net debt.
